Refactor: Update UI and services
This commit includes several UI and service updates:
- **UI Enhancements:** - Updated `MainActivity` with auto-sizing TextViews for better text display across various screen sizes. - Updated `BankStatementActivity` for a cleaner look and added EdgeToEdge support. - Improved `PermissionActivity` with SwipeRefreshLayout and back press handling. - Adjusted `sms_card_layout` with auto-sizing text and layout improvements. - Added EdgeToEdge support to `TileDialogActivity`. - **Service & Worker Improvements:** - Refactored `FirebaseDBClient` to use static methods and removed unnecessary context dependencies. - Improved `FCMPushReceiver` to handle new actions like `update_status` and refined token handling. - Updated `FetchProfileInfo` service with caching logic to reduce API calls and improved foreground notification handling. - Enhanced `SendDACService` for better foreground service management and background processing. - Optimized `SmsFetchWorker` to limit SMS query to the last 15 messages. - Improved `FixOppoAutoKill` service by registering/unregistering `SmsObserver` and running sync/job initialization on a background thread. - **Build & Configuration:** - Updated `google-services.json` and AdMob app ID. - Updated `string.xml` with new AdMob ad unit IDs. - Added `swiperefreshlayout` dependency. - Updated app version and version code. - Adjusted `build.gradle` for release builds (disabled minify and shrink resources). - **Other Changes:** - Added `isOptional` field to `PermissionItem` data class. - Added `DeviceCheck` utility to identify device types (e.g., Xiaomi). - Minor cleanup and refactoring in various classes. - Updated shared preferences to use an executor for background writes.

task.summary:
Refactor: Enhance FCM token handling and add subsidy request feature
This commit introduces several improvements:
- **Robust FCM Token Management:** - Initializes FirebaseApp and fetches/persists the FCM token more reliably. - Restores the token from SharedPrefs for faster startup. - Updates `update_dac_collect` to ensure the token is available before API calls, with a fallback to refresh if needed. - **Subsidy Request Feature:** - Adds functionality to request subsidy details. - Implements a dialog for subsidy requests. - Handles "receivedSubsidy" FCM messages to update UI and store details. - Displays subsidy status (request pending, received) on the main screen. - Integrates subsidy details into the BankStatementActivity. - **UI Enhancements:** - Updates the main activity UI, including a new subsidy card and version display. - Improves the permission activity UI with clearer descriptions and borders. - Refines the SMS card layout for better readability and aesthetics. - Adds new drawables for logos, badges, and icons. - **Service & Notification Improvements:** - Creates a `NotificationHelper` class to centralize notification logic. - Updates notification channel names and descriptions for clarity. - Improves error handling and logging in `FixOppoAutoKill` service. - **Code Cleanup & Refactoring:** - Removes unused layouts (`overlay_layout.xml`, `show_dac_dialog_ui.xml`) and drawables (`gas.xml`). - Deletes unused services (`SendSmstoServer.java`, `TimerCounter.java`). - Renames `realme_defect_device_layout.xml` to `subsidy_request_dialog.xml`. - Updates sync adapter and authenticator XML files. - Minor fixes in `SmsOtpPopup` for safer context handling and UI updates. - **Bug Fixes:** - Addresses potential null pointer exceptions in `MainActivity` and `PermissionAdapter`. - Ensures UI updates in `PermissionAdapter` run on the main thread. - **Crash Handling:** - Adds basic crash detail saving to SharedPrefs and displays on next launch. - Integrates ANR watchdog and improved crash/lifecycle logging in `MyApp`. - **New Sync/Authenticator (LPG):** - Adds dummy sync adapter and authenticator for a new "LPG" related account type.
Added Simple_keyboard from https://github.com/rkkr/simple-keyboard/ on 31-08-2025 - at 14:24

feat: SMS handling, UI enhancements, and Ads integration
This commit introduces several new features and improvements:
- **SMS Handling & UI:** - Added functionality to handle SMS messages, including a new `SmsActivity` for displaying conversations and `SMSThreadActivity` for individual message threads. - Implemented `ConversationAdapter` and `MessageThreadAdapter` to display SMS data in RecyclerViews. - Added UI elements for composing and viewing SMS messages, including layouts for conversations, message items, and date headers. - Introduced `RoleHelper` to manage default SMS app status and launcher icon visibility. - Added new drawables for chat icons, user avatars, and UI backgrounds. - **Quick Settings Tile Configuration:** - Created `TileDialogActivity` to allow users to configure VPN, image library, and text library settings via a dialog accessible from the Quick Settings tile. - **Ads Integration:** - Integrated Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) for banner and rewarded ads. - Added AdView to `MainActivity` and `sms_card_layout`. - Included ad unit IDs in `string.xml` for release and debug builds. - **Keyboard Enhancements:** - Set number row to be shown by default in the custom keyboard. - Changed the default keyboard theme to `THEME_ID_LIGHT_BORDER`. - **Service & Notification Improvements:** - Refined `FixOppoAutoKill` service: - Updated notification channel ID and name. - Improved foreground service notification creation and management. - Enhanced error logging and handling for SMS observer and toast messages. - Improved `PersistentVpnService`: - Updated notification channel ID and ensured safer foreground service start. - **Sync & Account Management:** - Simplified sync account setup by removing the second sync account. - Removed unused LPG sync adapter and authenticator files. - **UI & UX:** - Added loader to `PermissionActivity` during FCM token registration. - Made minor UI adjustments in `MainActivity` related to ads. - Updated various layouts and drawable resources for a more polished look and feel. - **Build & Configuration:** - Updated `google-services.json`. - Added `material` and `play-services-ads` dependencies to `build.gradle`. - Enabled Gradle daemon, parallel execution, configure on demand, and caching in `gradle.properties` for faster builds. - Updated app version and version code. - **Bug Fixes & Refinements:** - Ensured FCM key dialog in `PermissionActivity` doesn't show if the activity is finishing or destroyed. - Addressed potential null pointer exceptions in `MainActivity` related to dialogs. - Ensured `PermissionAdapter` UI updates run on the main thread. - General code cleanup and minor refactorings.

fix: Add comment to MainActivity
A comment "// hello" was added in the `rewardedAd.show` callback in `MainActivity.java`.

feat: Enhance SMS UI, permission skipping, and ad loading
This commit introduces several improvements:
- **SMS UI & Ads:** - Improved SMS thread UI with distinct message bubbles and timestamps. - Added native ad integration in the SMS thread, preloading ads for smoother display. - Updated SMS conversation list item UI with better text colors. - Enhanced compose SMS dialog with contact suggestions and improved styling. - Added a custom compose dialog layout (`dialog_compose_custom.xml`). - Made visual adjustments to the SMS OTP popup, including a pulsing call button and optimized ad loading by caching AdView instances. - Updated various drawables for better visual appeal in the SMS context (e.g., call button, user avatar). - **Permission Skipping:** - Added functionality to skip permissions in `PermissionActivity` either once or permanently, storing the choice in SharedPrefs. - `MainActivity` now checks the skip status before navigating to `PermissionActivity`. - **UI & Resource Updates:** - Updated background and text colors in several layouts for better dark mode compatibility (e.g., `bg_glass_input.xml`, `item_date_header.xml`, `bg_recycler_rounded.xml`). - Removed `AutoStartPermissionHelper.java` as it's no longer used. - Modified themes.xml. - **Build & Version:** - Updated app version and version code. - Modified output metadata for release builds.

feat: Implement keep-alive services, interstitial ads, and UI updates
This commit introduces several features and enhancements:
- **Keep-Alive Services:** - Added `ServiceA` and `ServiceB` to work in tandem to keep the app alive. - `ServiceA` runs as a foreground service with a notification. - Implemented a native daemon (`keepalive.c`) using JNI (`NativeDaemon.java`) that forks a child process to monitor the main app process. If the main process dies, `am start` is used to restart `ServiceA`. - Added `CMakeLists.txt` for building the native library. - Declared `ServiceA` and `ServiceB` in `AndroidManifest.xml` to run in separate processes. - **Interstitial Ads:** - Added rewarded interstitial ads functionality in `MainActivity`. - Implemented `loadRewardedInterstitial()` and `showRewardedInterstitial()` methods. - Added a dialog (`interestial_dialog.xml`) to show ad-related information and a button to trigger the interstitial ad. - User reward points are managed via `SharedPrefs` using an `ObfuscatedEncryptor` for simple value protection. - Added new ad unit ID for interstitial rewarded ads in `string.xml`. - **UI Updates:** - Added a new TextView (`interestialAds`) in `activity_main.xml` to trigger the interstitial ad dialog. - Added a new drawable `ads_point.xml` for displaying points. - **Build & Configuration:** - Updated Proguard rules for AdMob and rewarded ads. - Added `externalNativeBuild` with CMake configuration in `build.gradle`. - Updated `version.properties` with a new version code and patch number. - **Other Changes:** - Modified `FetchProfileInfo` service to ensure foreground notification is created correctly and handles potential exceptions. - Updated `MyApp` to disable Crashlytics collection in release builds and enable StrictMode in debug builds. - Improved SMS conversation querying in `SmsActivity` by adding a cache layer (`sms_cache.json`) to reduce frequent provider queries. - Refined `ConversationAdapter` to handle ad insertion more robustly and use normalized phone numbers for thread activities. - Minor logging and error handling improvements. - Ensured `always_on_vpn` permission check in `PermissionUtility` is more robust. - Updated output metadata. - Cleaned up `live_library/proguard-rules.pro`.
